proposal.hypothesis: Prior OpenMP variants with per-worker grain thresholds have similar aggregate means, but available timings do not establish the serial/parallel crossover by size. This experiment tests a contrasting fixed total-work cutoff: keep the serial path below 2048 options, then request the full passed thread budget (capped by n) with static scheduling. It may avoid region overhead for smaller inputs while improving use of the budget on larger inputs; no gain is assumed.

retained: Replaced per-worker grain-based team sizing with a generic fixed total-work serial cutoff of 2048 options.
Above the cutoff, use static OpenMP scheduling with a team capped at min(threads, n); retain the serial path for one-or-fewer threads and small inputs.
Preserved the per-option computation and one distinct output write per loop iteration.
